start.text:
Ironkeep — a frontier fortress on the border of the Savage Lands — is under siege. A warlord named Krag the Unbroken has united the orc tribes and marches on the keep with five hundred warriors.

Commander Vale, the fortress's leader, meets you in the war room. 'We have two hundred defenders and three days of supplies. Reinforcements are seven days away. We need to hold — or find a way to break the siege.'

She spreads a map on the table. 'The enemy camps in the valley below. What's your recommendation?'

choices.text: Fortify the walls and prepare for a direct defense
Lead a nighttime raid on the enemy camp
Find the secret tunnel under the keep to flank them
Attempt diplomacy — find out what Krag wants

fortify.text:
You spend the day reinforcing gates, positioning archers, and boiling oil for the battlements. Morale improves as soldiers see action being taken.

At dusk, the first assault comes — a wave of orc warriors charging the main gate with a battering ram.

choices.text: Command the archers to focus fire on the ram!
Pour boiling oil from the gatehouse!
Lead a sortie to destroy the ram
Continue

ram_stopped.text:
The battering ram is destroyed! Orc warriors scatter under a hail of arrows. The first assault is repelled, and a cheer goes up from the defenders.

But Krag is patient. He'll try again. During the night, scouts report the orcs building siege ladders.

choices.text: Prepare for the ladder assault at dawn
Launch a night raid to destroy the ladders
Search for the keep's secret tunnel to strike behind enemy lines

ram_through.text:
The battering ram hits the gate with tremendous force! The wood splinters but holds — barely. Defenders rush to reinforce it.

You drive the attackers back, but the gate is weakened.

choices.text: Barricade the gate and prepare for the ladder assault
Raid the enemy camp to buy time
Continue

sortie_success.text: You lead twenty soldiers through a side gate. Catching the orcs off-guard, you smash their battering ram and set fire to their supply wagons before retreating behind the walls. A devastating blow!

choices.text: Press the advantage — raid their camp tonight
Shore up defenses for the inevitable retaliation

sortie_retreat.text: The sortie is met with fierce resistance. You destroy the ram but lose three soldiers in the retreat.

choices.text: Focus on defense going forward

night_raid.text: Under cover of darkness, you lead a strike team of your best fighters into the orc camp. The enemy sentries are drowsy.

choices.text: Target their weapon stores
Assassinate Krag in his command tent
Free the prisoners the orcs have taken from nearby villages
Continue

stores_burned.text:
You torch the weapon stores! Flames leap high as orc armor, arrows, and siege materials go up in smoke. The camp erupts in chaos.

You escape in the confusion. Without siege equipment, Krag's options are limited.

choices.text: Press the advantage — the siege is weakened

stores_fight.text: A sentry spots you! A frantic fight breaks out near the supplies. You manage to set fire to half the stores before retreating.

choices.text: Return to the keep and prepare for the response
Continue

krag_confronted.text:
You slip into Krag's command tent. The massive orc warlord sits alone, studying maps by candlelight. He looks up.

'Bold. Foolish, but bold.' He doesn't reach for a weapon. 'You've come to kill me? Or to talk?'

choices.text: Attack — end this siege now!
Talk. What do you really want?

krag_alarm.text: Guards spot you before you reach the tent! You fight your way out and back to the keep.

choices.text: Prepare for the retaliation attack
Continue

krag_defeated.text:
The duel is fierce but brief. Krag is powerful, but you're faster. Your blade finds its mark. The warlord falls.

Without their leader, the orc army dissolves into feuding factions by morning. The siege lifts.

choices.text: Return to Ironkeep victorious

krag_survives.text: Krag is terrifyingly strong. He throws you across the tent. Guards rush in. You barely escape.

choices.text: Retreat to the keep

krag_talk.text:
Krag's voice is weary. 'My people starve. The Savage Lands grow colder each winter. Ironkeep sits on fertile ground and your king refuses to negotiate. I siege because my people have no other choice.'

He fixes you with a piercing stare. 'If you could convince your Commander to share even a portion of the harvest... there need be no more bloodshed.'

choices.text: Bring this proposal to Commander Vale
This is a trick — attack!

diplomacy.text:
You approach the orc lines under a white flag. Krag agrees to parley at a neutral site between the armies.

The warlord is articulate, surprising for one nicknamed 'the Unbroken.' He explains his people face famine, and Ironkeep's lands are their last hope.

choices.text: Propose a trade agreement to Commander Vale
This is a ploy — return and prepare defenses

peace_terms.text:
Commander Vale listens, conflicted. 'Share our harvest with orcs? The Crown would call that treason.' She paces. 'But if we can end this without more death...'

She proposes terms: shared farming rights on neutral ground, in exchange for a non-aggression pact and orc warriors helping defend the border.

choices.text: Present the terms to Krag
The military can't make treaties — defend the keep instead

tunnel.text: Old blueprints reveal a forgotten tunnel beneath the keep, emerging behind the orc camp. It's collapsed in places but passable with effort.

choices.text: Lead a strike force through the tunnel
Continue

tunnel_success.text: You emerge behind enemy lines! The orcs have no idea you're there. From this position, you can strike at their supply lines, their command tent, or signal the keep for a coordinated attack.

choices.text: Attack Krag's command tent
Burn their supplies and retreat
Signal the keep for a coordinated two-front attack

tunnel_collapse.text: Part of the tunnel collapses! You dig out, bruised, and emerge behind enemy lines covered in dust.

choices.text: Press on — strike at the command tent
Burn what you can and retreat through the tunnel

free_prisoners.text:
You find a cage of captured villagers — farmers, their families. You cut them free. An old man grips your hand: 'Thank you. They were going to sell us.'

The rescued villagers join the defense, boosting morale significantly.

choices.text: Return to the keep with the freed prisoners

ladder_assault.text:
Dawn brings the main assault. Orcs surge toward the walls with crude ladders. Dozens of them scale simultaneously while archers provide covering fire.

The walls are under pressure. Commander Vale shouts: 'Hold the line!'

choices.text: Fight at the wall — push the ladders off!
Direct the defense from the tower — tactical command
Continue
Continue

wall_held.text:
The defenders hold! Ladders are thrown down, orcs repelled with arrows and steel. The assault breaks against Ironkeep's walls like waves against a cliff.

Krag's forces pull back. But this isn't over — he's regrouping for a final push.

choices.text: Prepare for the final battle

wall_breach.text: Orcs breach the eastern wall! A desperate melee erupts in the courtyard. You fight hand-to-hand for every foot of ground. Eventually the breach is sealed, but at cost.

choices.text: Rally for the final stand

final_stand.text:
Day three. The final assault. Krag commits everything — every warrior, every siege machine. The sky darkens with arrows. War drums pound.

But from the east, a horn sounds — reinforcements! They've arrived early! A column of cavalry charges the orc flank.

Krag's army is caught between the keep and the cavalry. It's now or never.

choices.text: Lead a charge out of the gates!
Rain fire from the walls as the cavalry hit them!
Continue

charge_victory.text:
The gates thunder open and Ironkeep's defenders pour out! Caught between two forces, the orc army shatters. Warriors throw down weapons and flee.

Krag stands alone on the battlefield, surrounded. He drives his sword into the ground. 'I yield.'

choices.text: Accept his surrender — the siege is over
Offer him the peace terms — end this for good

charge_hard.text: The charge is brutal — orcs don't flee easily. You take heavy hits but the cavalry breaks their will. Krag surrenders.

choices.text: Accept the surrender

peace_victory.text:
Krag accepts the terms — shared farmland, mutual defense, no more raiding. It's unprecedented: humans and orcs, working together on the frontier.

Commander Vale signs the accord. 'This is either the bravest or stupidest thing I've ever done. Let's hope it's the former.'

Krag clasps your arm in the orc way. 'You fight with honor, and you think with wisdom. My people will remember this.'

Ironkeep stands. The siege ends not with massacre, but with understanding. Your name is carved into the fortress walls as both hero and peacemaker — a rare combination.

Sometimes, the greatest victory is the battle you don't have to fight.

victory.text:
The siege of Ironkeep is broken! The orc army scatters. Krag is imprisoned in the fortress dungeons, and the border is secure.

Commander Vale, bloodied but standing, addresses her troops: 'Today you fought for every stone of this fortress. Today you proved that Ironkeep is unbreakable.'

She turns to you. 'And you — hero of Ironkeep — without your courage, we'd have fallen on day one.'

King's messengers arrive with commendations: a title, a reward, and the eternal gratitude of the realm. Your name joins the legends carved into Ironkeep's walls, alongside warriors who have defended this fortress for centuries.

Ironkeep stands. As it always has. As it always will.
